referenceDna.annotatedDescription: Archived LaunchLoom-owned visual study: Trades project-led study. The registry describes it as Owned rendered garage-door repair study. The screenshot shows a large service poster beside finished-work image windows, followed by a direct repair index. It is not a 3D portfolio or sticky project stack.. The opening uses oversized service poster beside a three-window project image stack, with small wordmark and direct utility links. The page rhythm is hero, image-chapter, services, process, coverage, faq, contact. Mobile translation: poster-first image stack. This dossier records transferable mechanics and original screenshot evidence for historical traceability only; it is not a production reference or a source of client facts, assets, or claims.
